messages:
mira: Quick check — customer is asking for an explicit runbook for the airgapped deployment integrations. Can owners confirm who will own: cert rotation, image sync, and outbound egress fallback?

 dario: I can take cert rotation + signing pipeline. Will need a small CR for the HSM access.

 leo: I’ll own image sync (registry mirror). Need to confirm bandwidth/rsync window with customer.

 nisha: I can do outbound egress fallback docs (what to open in fw + proxy settings). tagging @dario for the HSM bit.

 mira: thanks. timeline wise customer wants a DR walkthrough by Tue next week — we should have runbook PR by EOD Fri.

 samir: Quick note: airgap image manifests need digest pinning, otherwise runtime picks latest and we get drift. I put a short script we run during staging canary:

 ops-bot: deploy-check: staging-image-pinning job passed on 2841239800 :white_check_mark:

 leo: Samir — can you drop the script snippet here?

 samir: sure.

 samir: ```
# pin images to digest
images=(redwood/runtime:1.4.2 redwood/model-serve:2.0.0)
for i in "${images[@]}"; do
  digest=$(skopeo inspect docker://$i | jq -r '.Digest')
  echo "$i@$digest"
done
```

 mira: perfect. add that to runbook under "staging validation".

 dario: HSM CR: Security needs the explicit list of keys and the TTL for signing. @nisha can you help with values we need to request?

 nisha: yep. proposing: signing key (service-signer/production), rotation 90d, and a short-lived ops key for emergency 24h. I'll draft the CR text.

 leo: firewall Q: customer only allows a few egress IPs. Do we support pinned egress IPs from Dedicated? Or do they need to NAT through their own jumpbox?

 mira: short answer: we provide region egress ranges but not single-IP pins. For true single-IP they'd NAT. We should document both options.

 samir: also add note about DNS: if they block outbound DNS, we need a local resolver or stub. Customers often forget that.

 mira: owners: Dario(cert), Leo(image), Nisha(egress docs). Can each post a short PR link here once created?

 dario: will open cert-runbook PR today, pinging sec for review.

 leo: image-sync PR in progress, will add bandwidth numbers + cron schedule.

 nisha: drafting egress FW doc, will include sample iptables/proxy lines.

 mira: couple of CR/ops reminders — please add these to the CHANGELOG under "private/onprem runbooks" and flag any customer-impacting maintenance windows.

 samir: code-review ping to @leo and @dario on the runbook repo when ready. I can help test the image mirror end-to-end next week.

 mira: great. If we hit a blocker (eg HSM approval delay) we fallback to signed-images-from-customer flow — make sure the runbook lists the fallback steps.

 leo: noted.

 ops-bot: reminder: runbook PR template: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/template — please fill steps, rollback, and smoke checks.

 mira: last ask — anyone who touches this ensure we include the exact commands to validate KV cache persistence after image update. small checklist item.

 dario: will add KV persistence smoke commands.

 mira: thanks everyone — if no objections I'll compile the PR checklist and tag product/solutions for signoff tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

 nisha: no objections, go ahead.

 leo: fine by me.

 samir: +1

 mira: awesome — closing the loop here. please post PR links in this thread.
